bullets.title: Gramatik - Orchestrated Incident
bullets.note:
I wrote a good portion of [The 4-Hour
Chef](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/v8ur85neeurhvqq96/60aeh8/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS80LUhvdXItQ2hlZi1Db29raW5nLUxlYXJuaW5nLUFueXRoaW5nL2RwLzA1NDc4ODQ1OTEvcmVmPWFzYXBfYmM_aWU9VVRGOA==)
(in fact, a book on accelerated learning) to this track on repeat. It’s not
everyone’s cup of tea, but I find the upbeat instrumentals fantastic for
writing flow. I have a lot of Gramatik and Beats Antique -- try
[Circulation](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/v8ur85neeurhvqq96/kmbmh6/aHR0cHM6Ly9zb3VuZGNsb3VkLmNvbS9iZWF0c2FudGlxdWUvY2lyY3VsYXRpb24=)
